user.title: Moonside
user.description: Select a discovered Moonside device to set up. Home Assistant uses the lamp's {identifier_type}, which may not match a printed hardware MAC address.

manual.title: Moonside
manual.description: Enter your Moonside device details manually using the lamp's {identifier_type} shown by Home Assistant or Bluetooth tools.

data_description.device_identifier: This may be a UUID or platform-specific Bluetooth identifier rather than a hardware MAC address.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Moonside
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({address})?

cloud.title: Moonside cloud state
cloud.description: Optionally sign in, create a Moonside cloud account, or send a password reset email. Home Assistant reads authoritative cloud state while continuing to control the lamp locally over Bluetooth. {status_message}

error.invalid_identifier: Enter a valid Bluetooth device identifier
error.incomplete_cloud_auth: Enter both cloud email and password, or leave both blank
error.email_already_exists: A cloud account already exists for that email address
error.email_not_found: No cloud account was found for that email address
